receipt-settings.027:
🖨️ Printing the receipt on a thermal printer

1️⃣ Set the size to match the printer's roll:
• 80mm roll (common, 3 inch): receipt size 80mm
• 58mm roll (small, 2 inch): receipt size 58mm
• Plain A4/A5 printer: receipt size A4 or A5

2️⃣ Write "receipt 12" — a PDF will come.

3️⃣ Open the PDF and Share / Print it:
• Bluetooth thermal printer: on Android, share it to RawBT or the "Bluetooth Print" app, pair the printer, and press Print.
• WiFi/USB printer: the phone's Print service (Settings → Printing) or the printer's own app.
• On a computer: set email ali@shop.com, then "email receipt 12" — open the email and print it.

4️⃣ Print a test receipt first. If it is cut or too small, check 80mm/58mm again, and choose "Actual size" in the print app (not "Fit to page").

Your lines: receipt footer ... · Order note: note 12 ... · All settings: receipt settings

ℹ️ The bot cannot connect to the printer directly — printing is done by the app on your phone or computer.
